n_encounters: 273 SCM encounters (138 int + 135 cont at post-peer)
intervention_detail: Enforcement of regulations (inspector visits) + Education (face-to-face 2x45min QAT) + Peer review (5 area group meetings)
outcome_definition: Non-prescription dispensing of requested low-dose antibiotics (cephalexin)
tier1_assessment_counselling: YES (asked no questions / gave no advice: 51% vs 81%)
notes: Post-peer review antibiotic dispensing: Int 71% (98/138) vs Cont 95% (128/135), p=0.0125. Baseline: 99% vs 97%.

intervention_detail: Semi-quantitative CRP point-of-care test kits provided + staff training on RTI viral/bacterial algorithm
comparator: Control pharmacies (no CRP kits / standard practice)
outcome_definition: Non-prescription antibiotic dispensing rate for RTI symptoms without prescription
outcome_assessment_method: Blinded Simulated Client visits (30 per PCP)
adjustment_variables: Multiple imputation, fixed effects: treatment, strata, client gender; random intercept: PCP cluster

intervention_detail: PINTAR: (1) WhatsApp online education (3 modules/3 wks); (2) Customer IEC campaign (6 mos); (3) Peer visits; (4) Branding & certification
tier2_antibiotic_selection_dose: Mixed-effects logistic (xtlogit): adjusted for pre-intervention dispensing, pharmacy structure, GP clinic attached, pharmacist present
exploratory_knowledge_attitude: YES (dispensing: URTI 41.3% vs 83.7%; UTI 72.5% vs 87.4%; Diarrhoea 52.5% vs 75.8%)
column43: Overall post-intervention dispensing: Participating 55.4% (133/240) vs Non-participating 82.3% (469/570). Univariate OR 0.12 (0.06-0.25), Multivariate OR 0.14 (0.07-0.30).

intervention_detail: Face-to-face educational outreach for counter attendants on acute respiratory infection (ARI) case management
outcome_definition: Non-prescription antibiotic dispensing for ARI presentation
adjustment_variables: Adjusted for clustering in Cochrane 2025 review synthesis
tier2_antibiotic_selection_dose: YES (antibiotic dispensing for ARI: 54% int vs 63% cont)
notes: Extracted from Cochrane 2025 systematic review (RR 0.85, 95% CI 0.66-1.09). Full text behind paywall (EAMJ 2004;81(Suppl):S33-S40).
